pages.title: Assemble a wand
pages.text: Use your wand on the wand workbench. The head sets power, speed and wear thresholds; head and shaft set durability; the tail sets melee damage. Replacement parts must be in your inventory.

Parts determine cooldown; circuit complexity also adds preparation time. Branches, long links and feedback increase complexity. Exceeding head thresholds adds wear. Creative casting does not consume durability.

Melee wears only the staff. Casting wears the active circuit board plus a small fractional amount of staff durability. An exhausted board stops supply without destroying the wand or preventing melee. Book casts wear their book board, not a board inside the wand.
